nonblocking_notes: Preflight establishes code/design readiness only. Actual remote availability, real schemas, total row preservation, all24 payload hashes, slim size and resource compliance must be checked after the run. Any mismatch is failure; do not silently omit rows/files or relax caps.

Transfer accounting measures bytes returned by application reads and preserved/logged chunks, not lower-level TCP/TLS traffic. This is the repository payload-budget measure; headers and unread redirect bodies are not dataset bytes.

The internal TransferBudget default wall guard is900seconds, stricter than outer intake1500seconds. It may cause a preserved technical failure; do not extend it after outcomes or hide retries. Outer workflow timeout/lock remains necessary.
Input SHA256 identifies the released input column, not necessarily system/provider prompts or a causal treatment. No exact counterfactual or latent faithfulness inference follows from intake.

Observed HF schema metadata was not revision-pinned; actual pinned Parquet footer validation is required and implemented. A schema failure requires a newly reviewed spec/attempt, not a silent adaptation.

R16/R17 scientific design, endpoint weighting, clustered split, support rules and simultaneous inference require separate bound independent preflight before outcome analysis. This acceptance makes no novelty, alignment-safety, positive-result or journal-readiness claim.
